언어 선정 참고: https://www.tiobe.com/tiobe-index/ (2026년 9월). 순위는 적의 강함을 의미하지 않습니다.

## Go
Official Go Gopher mascot from golang/website repository
https://github.com/golang/website/blob/master/_content/images/gophers/blue.svg
Go Gopher mascot by Renee French, CC-BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Original artwork unchanged; credit Renee French. This is the official mascot, not the Go wordmark.

## Kotlin
Devicon distribution of full Kotlin mark plus wordmark
https://github.com/devicons/devicon/blob/master/icons/kotlin/kotlin-original-wordmark.svg
Full gradient mark plus wordmark retained without recoloring, with original spacing. Distribution is Devicon, not certified byte-identical official brand ZIP. Respect Kotlin brand guidance and preserve Devicon MIT license. Official package https://resources.jetbrains.com/storage/products/kotlin/docs/kotlin_logos.zip .
